[[File:Sundari-Corruption.png|thumb|right|250px|The domed city of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari.]]]]
{{Quote|A jungle world. Domed cities I see. Rodia it is.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="Children of the Force">{{TCW|Children of the Force}}</ref>}}
A '''domed city''' was a type of [[City/Legends|settlement]] characterized by a hemispherical dome that covered it. Such cities were employed on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] or in planetary regions where natural environments were inhospitable to the physiology of their inhabitants. For example, the [[Geelan]] of the planet [[Needan]] used domed cities to protect themselves from their world's frigid temperatures.<ref name="Alien Encounters">''[[Alien Encounters]]''.</ref> Similarly, the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Species/Legends|species]] used domed cities to shelter themselves from the caustic [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]].<ref name="A Fistful of Credits">{{WEGCite|story=A Fistful of Credits|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Screen}}</ref> [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] faction on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], was also covered with a [[black]] dome due to inhospitable [[Desert/Legends|desert]] conditions.<ref name="The Mandalore Plot">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref> The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] of the planet [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] also used domed cities.<ref name="Children of the Force" /> The [[Human/Legends|Humans]] of [[Nox (planet)|Nox]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] use domed cities, the planet was polluted to such a level that the inhabitants had to live in domed cities that were supplied with filtered air, With nearly ninety domed cities altogether established on the planet dedicated to the production and refinement of ore.
